messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Mar 03, 2023, Broto Santoso via AMBER wrote:
>
>My OS offers to upgrade packages, is it ok to continue for NVidia driver
>upgrading? I attached a screenshot about this. Will these affect the amber
>applications?
In my (limited!) experience, the details of the driver don't matter to
Amber: that is the driver should be able to be updated.  But check that
nothing bad happens.  And you might want to wait a few days to see if anyone
else on the list has had a bad experience here.
....dac
